The DATE is anchorable to a primary filing, not just Rev metadata: .../2026-07-08_supplemental-notice-access-to-evidence_dc28443912.txt (Erika Kirk, victim representative, via Neiman) asks the court to "Order that all exhibits ... be so published during the proceedings scheduled for July 9, 2026, so that all persons lawfully present in the courtroom may view them" — and day4 opens at 02:08:54–03:01:18 granting exactly that relief for Exs. 16/16.1/16.2/16.3, with Neiman arguing at 01:15:22. BUT THE MAP'S "in full" HALF IS NOT MERELY UN-UPGRADED, IT IS CONTRADICTED BY T1. Graf's findings from the bench, day5.txt 48:51–49:49, expressly accepted by BOTH counsel (McBride 50:18 "your recitation is accurate"; Novak 50:33 "I don't take issue with the court's factual summary"): "The portion displayed on the monitors did not contain the full note, and consisted of approximately 78 words. Approximately 15 of those words were included in the information filed on September 16th, 2026 [Rev/bench slip for 2025 — the Information is dated 2025-09-16; normalisation MARKED]. In addition, the full note was read into the record during the preliminary hearing." (Graf says "exhibit 16" where content — "the full note" — indicates the note exhibit 16.3; content wins over the label.) So the record establishes the note was READ in full, not SHOWN in full. The map's calibration rationale is also refuted: Graf found "The full text of exhibit 16 had previously been made public through a search warrant that was publicly available on or before April 2026" — i.e. a LAWFUL prior public source for any media rendering, not the unlawful-capture inference the map drew. "Luna": corpus sweep across 71 banked .txt artifacts (BAM/"Reckless Ben" mis-banked file EXCLUDED), both U+FFFE readings via artifact_search.find — pattern 'Luna' returns exactly ONE hit corpus-wide, the examiner's question at day4 02:31:56; there is no salutation anywhere. Distinctive full-text phrases 'on a mission', 'auto ?text', 'lengthy prison', 'find joy', 'love you always', 'stayed for you' are ALL null under both readings (capable patterns — each is a verbatim string from the profile's §8 rendering). The banked Rev transcript does not carry the reading Graf describes: day4 03:04:12ff is heavily [inaudible] exactly where Hunt reads from 16.3 — an access-path caveat, not evidence the reading did not happen. Three materially different T1 renderings of the key line now exist and the map caught only one: Information (2025-09-16) "…and I'm going to take it"; defence brief (2026-08-11) "…and I took it"; day4 Hunt reading in ARGUMENT (Rev garble) "I have the opportunity to take out Charlie Kirk from the tickets." The map's parenthetical 'photograph of notes' is NOT a verbatim quote — Hunt's actual words are "the photo law enforcement obtained from Mr. Twiggs's phone."
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: SPLIT, rewritten. (a) T1 — Ex. 16.3, a PHOTOGRAPH of the note recovered from Mr. Twiggs's phone, was admitted 2026-07-09 and published to the courtroom only, not to be captured by media (day4 03:01:18, 05:12:39; date anchored by dkt 2026-07-08 supplemental notice). (b) "shown in full in court" — DELETE: contradicted by T1. Graf's unopposed day5 findings are that the displayed portion "did not contain the full note" (~78 words) and that "the full note was read into the record." Supported form: "the full note was read into the record at the preliminary hearing; the portion displayed on the monitors was partial." (c) "is addressed to 'Luna'" — remains T1 via T3 (The Hill / ABC4) and must be flagged as UNCORROBORATED BY ANY PRIMARY DOCUMENT IN THIS LIBRARY: 'Luna' is a single-hit null-equivalent corpus-wide. q142_verdicts.claim: "Hometown: St. George, Utah."
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened day4.txt, the defence brief, and the contempt transcript. The split is right in structure and the T1 half CONFIRMS, but the map mis-cites and over-scopes it. Residence: day4 02:14:52 Twiggs "St. George in an apartment complex" — CONFIRMED verbatim. The phrase "the same place you lived on September 10th" is the EXAMINER'S at 02:14:55, not Twiggs's at 02:15:00; Twiggs's 02:15:00 turn is the one-word answer "Yes." A questioner's premise is not the witness's words — the map attributes counsel's phrasing to Twiggs. Faumuina: the quote is at 05:00:45, not 05:00:51 (05:00:51 is McBride's next question): "One of them was where Mr. Robinson and Mr. Twiggs resided, and the other was Robinson's parents' residence," framed by McBride 04:59:27 "did you go to St. George?" / 04:59:34 "what was your role in St. George?" — live sworn testimony, CONFIRMED. Defence brief CONFIRMED verbatim: "A search was later conducted of the residence Mr. Robinson shared with Lance Twiggs in St. George, Utah. PH3:35." Also corroborating, Agent Davis day4 02:58:07: "Lance's first interview at St. George PD." CAPACITY CORRECTION THE MAP MISSES ENTIRELY: the 02:14:52 material is NOT live courtroom testimony. day4 02:11:04–02:33:59 is a block Rev labels "Video" — a video-recorded sworn statement played as State's Ex. 16, in which the examiner states at 02:11:04 "This meeting is to use your statement here instead of your testimony at a preliminary hearing," administers the oath, gives the Class A misdemeanour false-statement admonition, and records the state and federal immunity agreements; the recording ends at 02:33:34 "I'm going to go ahead and end the recording for the 11:02 purposes" (Rev garble for Rule 1102 — normalisation MARKED, and corroborated below). Independently T1-confirmed: the defence brief describes St.Ex. 16 as "a recorded interview between the Utah County Attorney's Office and witness Lance Twiggs"; Graf's 2026-06-22 contempt ruling calls it "a video recorded interview of Mr. Twiggs conducted pursuant to Utah Rule of Evidence 1102" and states "The State does not intend to call Mr. Twiggs to testify live at the preliminary hearing"; Hunt dates it day4 02:38:23ff to "April 20th, 2026 at the Utah County Attorney's Office." Nulls for the T3 half, both readings, 71 files, BAM excluded: 'hometown' 0; 'grew up' 0; 'raised in' hits are all unrelated ("issue raised in", "concerns raised in", "slightly raised in relation") — no "raised in <place>" for Mr. Twiggs. Patterns capable: 'hometown' and 'grew up' are the exact stems of the thing claimed absent. DIRECTION/LIVING-PERSONS: the T1 supports residence AS OF SEPTEMBER 2025 ONLY. Graf's 2026-06-22 ruling records that by then compulsory process would have to reach him out of state, so a present-tense "lives in St. George" would be both unsupported and a residence detail about a private individual.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: SPLIT, date-scoped. T1 — Mr. Twiggs and Mr. Robinson shared a residence in St. George, Utah AS OF 2025-09-10 (Twiggs, sworn recorded statement admitted as State's Ex. 16 under Utah R. Evid. 1102, day4 02:14:52 with the follow-up affirmed at 02:15:00; Sgt. Faumuina, live sworn testimony, day4 05:00:45; defence brief 2026-08-11 citing PH3:35). Cite Twiggs's own five words only; do not attribute the examiner's "same place you lived on September 10th" to him. T3 UNCHANGED for "hometown" / where raised — null corpus-wide under both U+FFFE readings on 'hometown' and 'grew up'. Add a standing capacity caveat wherever Twiggs is cited from day4: recorded sworn statement taken by the Utah County Attorney's Office on 2026-04-20 and played in court, NOT live testimony, and not subject to cross-examination — Graf denied the defence's application to compel his live attendance. Do not state any current residence.

q142_verdicts.claim: "Reportedly a gifted pianist… a Facebook profile listed Utah Tech University; described himself online as a 'digital creator' and aspiring professional gamer. No authoritative confirmation of degree completion exists in public records."
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened ~/Documents/Kirk Robinson Research/lance-twiggs-comprehensive-profile.md (v1.3) and grepped it directly. THE ROW TARGETS TEXT THAT IS NOT IN THE FILE. 'Utah Tech' — 0 hits in the profile. 'digital creator' — 0. 'professional gamer' — 0. 'aspiring' — 0. 'degree completion' — 0. 'Facebook profile' — 0. The only surviving fragment is 'pianist' at line 226, and it is NOT in §1.1: it sits in the later friends/character section, already correctly framed as a recording-layer attribution ("Friends quoted by Times of India and Hindustan Times (late Sept. 2025) described a 'good kid,' a straight-A student and gifted pianist"). The map was therefore built against a pre-Q140 draft, and a marking of "unchanged (T3/T4)" has no claim in the current file to leave unchanged. Verifications that DO hold, logged as confirmations: the null half is real. Corpus sweep, 71 banked .txt artifacts, BAM/"Reckless Ben" mis-banked file EXCLUDED, both U+FFFE readings via artifact_search.find — 'Utah Tech' 0, 'pian' 0 (stem, capable of pianist/piano/pianos), 'digital creator' 0, 'professional gam' 0 (stem, capable of gamer/gaming), 'Dixie State' 0, 'music' 0. Positive control confirms the sweep can see the subject matter: 'gam(e|ing|er)' returns 10 hits. The T1 occupation fact CONFIRMS verbatim: day4 02:15:21, in answer to "at that time, let's say September of 2025, what were you doing with your life? Were you working, school?" — "I was working. I was doing bathtub and shower repair and stuff and new construction." DIRECTION ERRORS IN THE MAP'S OWN CITATIONS: (a) 02:22:05 does not support anything about Mr. Twiggs's gaming — the answer is "This is his friend group. They played D&D together every week," describing MR. ROBINSON'S Discord friend group, tabletop play, not Twiggs. (b) "the record shows recreational, not professional, gaming" overstates: 02:29:31–02:30:19 is Twiggs describing games the two played together (party games, Sea of Thieves, co-op, "way back when" shooting games). q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: NO RE-MARKING — row not executable; the claim as quoted was removed from the profile before v1.3. Do not re-insert it to mark it. Three separable follow-ons, each on its own footing: (1) LEAVE line 226's "gifted pianist" exactly as it stands — T3 recording-layer attribution to named outlets, correctly not adopted; add nothing. (2) OPTIONAL T1 ADD, generic form only: "Employed in construction-trade work as of September 2025 (T1 — Twiggs, recorded sworn statement admitted as State's Ex. 16, day4 02:15:21)." Drop the specific trade: it adds nothing to any public question under investigation and is identifying detail about a private individual. (3) If any professional-gaming characterisation is ever recorded, mark it T4-as-claimed with the null stated WITH ITS SCOPE: "no reference to professional gaming appears in the 71 banked court-record artifacts, searched under both U+FFFE readings on the stem 'professional gam'; this is a null over the banked corpus only, not evidence of absence."

q142_verdicts.claim: Robinson's mother told investigators, per the charging document, that her son "began to date his roommate, a biological male who was transitioning genders."
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened the Information and the Gray transcript. The quote CONFIRMS VERBATIM in .../2025-09-16_information-charging-document_dc27880532.txt, and the section is confirmed: it sits under the heading "The Washington County Investigation," after "Robinson's mother stated the following to police," and the antecedent of "She" is confirmed by the immediately preceding sentence "Robinson's mother explained that over the last year or so, Robinson had become more political…" — so the attribution to the mother is correct, not inferred. Gray reading it aloud also CONFIRMS: /2026-08-16_rev_update-on-charlie-kirk-shooter.txt, inside the Jeff Gray turn opening at 10:00, at ~18:00, near-verbatim ("trans rights" unhyphenated is the only variance). THREE NARROWINGS THE MAP MISSES. (1) "and independently T2" is REFUTED. Gray is reading his own filed Information aloud at the charging press conference — I traced the speaker labels and the whole block from 10:00 is Gray reciting the document. That is one source in two forms, which the project standard expressly declines to count twice ("syndicated recaps are one source, not many"). It corroborates that the filing says this; it corroborates nothing about the underlying fact. (2) THE INFORMATION DOES NOT NAME MR. TWIGGS. It says "his roommate" throughout; 'Twigg' is a total null in the Gray transcript too — Gray never spoke the name. The roommate = Twiggs identification is separately T1-supported by the defence brief, which quotes the Information's "police questioned the roommate." Information at 3" and then writes "The State alleges that by telling Mr. Twiggs to exercise his right…". Cite that link explicitly rather than letting §1.2 silently supply the name. (3) THE FILING IS SWORN ON INFORMATION AND BELIEF, NOT FIRST-HAND. Its closing reads: "Based upon evidence received from Brian Davis of the Utah State Bureau of Investigations, I have reason to believe the defendant committed the offense(s) as charged herein… Sworn to by: JEFFREY S. GRAY." So the chain is mother → police → Agent Davis → Gray → filing. T1 attaches to the filing, never to the content.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 — as the content of a primary court filing, NOT as an adjudicated or independently verified fact. Mark exactly: "T1 (Information, 2025-09-16, probable-cause statement, §'The Washington County Investigation') — the State's charging document records Robinson's mother's account to police. Sworn to by Utah County Attorney Jeffrey S. Gray on information and belief, based on evidence received from Agent Brian Davis; the filing says 'his roommate' and does not name Mr. Twiggs (the identification rests on the defence's 2026-08-11 brief, also T1). Read aloud by Gray at the 2025-09-16 charging conference — the SAME source in a second form, NOT independent T2 corroboration." Retain the map's recording-layer note verbatim: this is the mother's statement to police as relayed in a charging document, not an adjudicated fact about a private individual's identity, and it is not adopted.

q142_verdicts.claim: Online researchers noted a gaming-platform display-name change from "Lance" to "Luna" (Times of India; Factually.co renders it "a Steam or Stream display name change").
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened the profile. THE ROW TARGETS TEXT THAT IS NOT IN THE FILE, and the file says so itself. lance-twiggs-comprehensive-profile.md line 394 records: "v1.1 item 6 is orphaned by the removal of the display-name passage it describes; noted, not rewritten." Grep confirms: 'Steam' and 'display-name' appear ONLY in the revision log at lines 359 and 394 — nowhere in §1.2. The passage was removed during Q-140, so "NOT upgradable as a display-name claim" is a marking with nothing left to mark. Like row 3, this shows the map was built against a pre-Q140 draft. What DOES hold, logged as confirmations with the map's errors corrected: the substitute T1 fact exists. day4 02:31:56, examiner: "Okay. And I understand you were going by Luna at some point?" and the ANSWER at 02:32:01, Twiggs: "To some people, yeah, but not as an overall thing." The map cites 02:31:56 for both; the answer is 02:32:01 — and the distinction matters, because 02:31:56 is the questioner's PREMISE, which is not evidence of anything. The map's gap boundary is also wrong: reading the raw lines, the turns run 02:31:12 (a complete Twiggs answer about politics), 02:31:29 (examiner, truncated: "Okay. So before that you have been?"), 02:31:54 (Twiggs: "Mm-hmm. For a short time, yes."). The unexplained interval is 02:31:29 → 02:31:54, twenty-five seconds, not 02:31:12 → 02:31:54. And the transcript carries NO redaction marker there — "redaction gap" is an inference from Hunt's day4 02:09:53 statement that the video was edited per court order with "large gaps of just black, empty, silent space." A reasonable inference, but it must be labelled as one. 'Luna' is otherwise a total null across the corpus (71 files, both U+FFFE readings, BAM excluded) — including a null in Graf's 2026-06-22 contempt ruling, which uses "Mr. Twiggs" and he/him throughout.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: NO RE-MARKING — row not executable; the display-name passage was removed in Q-140 and must not be re-inserted in order to be marked. The salvageable T1 fact is a RECORDING-LAYER entry only, and must not become an analyst conclusion about a living person's name or identity: "T1 — asked in his 2026-04-20 recorded sworn statement (State's Ex. 16, played 2026-07-09) whether he was going by Luna, Mr. Twiggs answered: 'To some people, yeah, but not as an overall thing.' (day4, question 02:31:56, answer 02:32:01.)" Attach: (a) the preceding examiner turn at 02:31:29 is truncated and is followed by an unexplained 25-second interval — apparently a court-ordered video edit per Hunt at 02:09:53, marked as an INFERENCE; the content must not be reconstructed; (b) §1.1's existing posture — following court-record usage "without taking a position on the dispute" — is CORRECT and this answer does not license changing it. Do NOT write that 'Luna' is "not a settled chosen name"; that is an analyst-layer conclusion about a private individual's identity that one answer in one recorded statement cannot carry. SEPARATE CONFIRMED UPGRADE the map missed: §1.1's "Judge Tony Graf's rulings… use 'Lance Twiggs' and he/him pronouns" is currently cited to KUER (T3) and is now directly T1 — .../2026-06-23-pub_rev-contempt-hearing-transcript.txt carries Graf's 2026-06-22 bench ruling using "Mr. Twiggs" and his/him throughout.

q142_verdicts.claim: Analytical note: "Kirk was shot while answering audience questions about mass shootings, in an exchange that had immediately referenced transgender shooters" (Washington Post: "a question from an audience member about responsibility for mass shootings").
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened the Information, the arrest affidavit, and the Gray transcript. The quote CONFIRMS VERBATIM in .../2025-09-16_information-charging-document_dc27880532.txt: "Approximately fifteen minutes into the event, Mr. Kirk was answering a question about mass shootings by transgender individuals when a gunshot rang out." The map is right that the primary is more specific than the WaPo paraphrase — WaPo's "responsibility for mass shootings" is a materially different characterisation from the filing's "mass shootings by transgender individuals." Gray reading it aloud CONFIRMS: I traced the speaker labels in /2026-08-16_rev_update-on-charlie-kirk-shooter.txt — the block from "Jeff Gray ( 01:10 )" runs unbroken to the next label at "Jeff Gray ( 10:00 )", and the sentence sits inside it at ~09:5x, near-verbatim ("approximately 15 minutes"). THREE NARROWINGS. (1) T1 attaches to the FILING, not the fact. The Information's closing is "Based upon evidence received from Brian Davis of the Utah State Bureau of Investigations, I have reason to believe… Sworn to by: JEFFREY S. GRAY." This is the State's charging allegation sworn on information and belief, not an adjudicated finding, and this project has not independently verified what question Kirk was answering. (2) "also T2" is not independent — Gray is reciting his own filing verbatim; same source, second form. (3) AN INTRA-T1 GAP THE MAP MISSED: the parallel primary document filed the same day, .../2025-09-16_affidavit-of-probable-cause_dc27880530.txt, does NOT contain this detail at all. I searched it under both U+FFFE readings: 'transgender' 0, 'transitioning' 0, 'fifteen minutes' 0. It says only "Charles was holding a microphone and speaking to a crowd. While speaking into the microphone, a loud gunshot was heard at approximately 1223 hours." So the transgender-question specificity appears in the Information and not in the arrest affidavit — that belongs in the file as a scope note before the upgrade lands. CONFIRMATION IN THE SUPPORTING DIRECTION, now upgradable from T3: §1.2's own analyst point that Gray "declined to go beyond the charging document" is directly verified in the transcript at 34:07–34:17 — asked by a Fox News reporter "Do you have any indication that transgender issues played a role in the motivations for this shooting?", Gray answered "I'm going to stick to what I just stated in my public… In our information. I think that is pretty much set forth there." Currently cited to The Advocate (T3); it is now T2 first-hand.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 AS ALLEGATION, replacing the WaPo paraphrase. Mark: "T1 (Information, 2025-09-16, probable-cause statement) — the State alleges: 'Approximately fifteen minutes into the event, Mr. Kirk was answering a question about mass shootings by transgender individuals when a gunshot rang out.' Sworn on information and belief by Utah County Attorney Jeffrey S. Gray based on evidence received from Agent Brian Davis; a charging allegation, not an adjudicated finding, and not independently verified by this project. Read aloud by Gray at the 2025-09-16 charging conference (~09:5x) — the same source in a second form, NOT independent T2." Add the scope note: the parallel 2025-09-16 arrest affidavit of probable cause contains no reference to the content of the question ('transgender', 'transitioning', 'fifteen minutes' all null under both U+FFFE readings) and records only that Kirk was "speaking into the microphone" when the shot was heard. Keep the analyst point unchanged, and UPGRADE its supporting citation from T3 (The Advocate) to T2 first-hand: Gray, 2025-09-16 charging conference at 34:17, declining to go beyond the Information when asked whether transgender issues played a role in the motivations. Anchors-vs-connections holds: that the State alleges Kirk was answering such a question is separate from, and does not evidence, any connection to Mr. Twiggs's identity.

q142_verdicts.claim: "No official source — prosecutor, court, or investigator — has asserted any connection between Twiggs' identity and Robinson's motive."
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened every artifact the map names. Information (2025-09-16_information-charging-document_dc27880532.txt): stem 'motiv' = 0 hits under BOTH U+FFFE readings via artifact_search.find — the document never uses the word; the charged theory is the enhancement, verbatim: 'In violation of Utah Code Ann. § 76-3-203.14(2), Tyler James Robinson intentionally selected Charlie Kirk because of Tyler James Robinson's belief or perception regarding Charlie Kirk's political expression.' Affidavit dc27880530: 'motiv','transgender','transition','gender' ALL 0 under both readings. Contempt transcript 2026-06-23-pub: 'transgender'/'transition'/'gender identity' 0 under both readings; its 3 unique 'motiv' hits all concern Mr. Twiggs' own 'motives to lie due to his immunity agreements' (impeachment), not Robinson's motive. Gray transcript: only 'motiv' hits are the Fox question at 34:07 and 'political motivation as an aggravating circumstance' at 35:48. day1/day3/day4/day5: 'motiv' = 0. THE NULL FAILS IN day2. At 03:27:23–03:29:56 the prosecutor arguing for the State (Judge at 03:05:21: 'Turning to the State… Mr. McBride'; defence identified at 00:09:51 as Nester/Burt/Novak/Visser 'here for Mr. Robinson') says the exhibit is 'relevant to the motive that we are alleging in this case,' that Kirk's political views were 'tied to his religious views about gender identity, LGBTQ rights type issues,' that 'the defendant's motive is that he was on the other side of those views,' that the State 'will offer evidence through other witnesses that talks about some of the defendant's statements that indicate his gender persuasion,' and 'motive in general which goes to identity.' Defence counsel Novak at 03:31:06 characterises it as 'their view of Mr. Robinson's motive, which has something to do with gender identity, gender ideology, and sexuality.' And the 2026-08-11 defence brief (T1 filing, signed Nester/Burt/Novak/Visser) states flatly that the State argues the 'hatred' referent turns on the two men's relationship and on Mr. Twiggs 'at least intermittently identifying as a female to his close friends,' and that 'the State focuses on Mr. Robinson's sexuality and Mr. Twiggs' gender identity.' DIRECTION DISCIPLINE (both ways): McBride never names Mr. Twiggs — his own words are about ROBINSON's views/'gender persuasion'; the Twiggs-identity attribution is OPPOSING COUNSEL'S CHARACTERISATION, not the State's own words, and the State's 2026-07-28 opening brief is NOT banked (checked the folder listing), so the State's own written version cannot be read. CONFIRMATIONS LOGGED FOR THE NULL: at day4 02:30:59 an investigator asked Mr. Twiggs directly 'did you ever talk about gender identity issues and LGBTQ rights?' — answer 'No, not really'; at 02:30:54 he 'personally had never heard him talk about Charlie Kirk before specifically.' A questioner's premise is not an assertion. Also: the map's gloss 'per his mother, that Kirk "spreads too much hate"' is misattributed — the Information puts that in ROBINSON's mouth ('Robinson explained there is too much evil and the guy [Charlie Kirk] spreads too much hate'), recounted by the parents; the affidavit's 'full of hate and spreading hate' is an unnamed 'family member.'
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: NOT 'a T1-scoped null that survives.' The absolute form cannot be banked at analyst layer. Supported form, scoped: "The Information charges no motive element at all — the word 'motive' does not appear in it (searched under both U+FFFE readings); its sole identity-adjacent allegation is the § 76-3-203.14(2) victim-targeting enhancement, keyed to Robinson's 'belief or perception regarding Charlie Kirk's political expression' [T1, read directly]. On the record this library holds, no prosecutor, court or investigator has in their OWN words tied Mr. Twiggs' identity to Robinson's motive — but this is a scoped absence, not evidence of absence, and it is contested: (a) the State's Day-2 argument (2026-07-07, day2 03:27–03:30) expressly grounds its alleged motive in 'gender identity, LGBTQ rights type issues' and says motive 'goes to identity,' referring to ROBINSON's views, not Mr. Twiggs' [T1]; (b) the defence's 2026-08-11 brief asserts that the State's argument does rest in part on Mr. Twiggs' gender identity [T1 filing, but opposing counsel's characterisation — attributed, not adopted]; (c) the State's own 2026-07-28 brief is NOT held, and Day-2/Day-3 sidebar argument is off the public record, so the search space is incomplete on exactly the point at issue. Counter-direction, logged: at day4 02:30:59 an investigator put the connection to Mr. Twiggs directly and he denied any such conversations." Keep the Gray sentence separate (see next row). Mr. Twiggs remains accused of nothing.

q142_verdicts.claim: Utah County Attorney Jeff Gray, asked directly at the Sept. 16, 2025 press conference whether "transgender issues played a role in the motivations," declined to go beyond the charging document (The Advocate).
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened .../2026-08-16_rev_update-on-charlie-kirk-shooter.txt. At 34:07 the questioner self-identifies in content — '[inaudible 00:34:09] with Fox News' — and asks verbatim: 'Do you have any indication that transgender issues played a role in the motivations for this shooting?' Gray at 34:17, verbatim: 'I'm going to stick to what I just stated in my public… In our information. I think that is pretty much set forth there.' 'Declined to go beyond the charging document' is a faithful paraphrase of 'stick to… our information.' q142_verdicts.claim: Robinson left the apartment around 4–5 a.m. on Sept. 10.

I would've thought it was 5:00 AM because that's when an early work day was for him, but it was probably more like 4:00." (b) The referent of "the group chat I mentioned" does not appear anywhere in the held playback (only `group chat` hit is line 1391, a friend's Instagram link), so the content and timing of that group message are NOT established in the held record — plausibly inside the redacted/fast-forwarded portion. q142_verdicts.claim: Robinson texted Twiggs: "Drop what you are doing, look under my keyboard" (charging documents).
q142_verdicts.basis: The "T1 twice over" half is CONFIRMED. Information `dc27880532.txt`, "The Roommate": "drop what you are doing, look under my keyboard." — read directly off the filing. `day4.txt` line 1828, Agent Davis under oath at 02:41:34, reading State's Exhibit 16.1 (photographs of the text thread from Twiggs' phone): "Drop what you're doing. Look under your keyboard." Both verified. The "my/your variant now visible at T1 on both sides" half OVERSTATES, on three findings the map does not have. (3) The "your" leg rests on ONE uncertified Rev rendering of an oral reading of a photograph — three removes from the exhibit — and counsel's own paraphrase at 02:57:43 reverts to "look under HIS keyboard". The divergence is therefore not established as a divergence in the exhibit; the more economical reading is a mis-reading or a Rev mis-hearing.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: **T1, twice over** — Information `dc27880532.txt` §"The Roommate" (primary filing, read directly) and `day4.txt` 02:41:34 (Davis's sworn in-court reading of admitted State's Exhibit 16.1). Do NOT mark a my/your textual variant "at T1 on both sides." Supported form: the filing reads "my keyboard"; Gray's 2025-09-16 reading of the filing reads "my keyboard"; the Rev rendering of Davis's oral reading reads "your keyboard", a single uncertified machine rendering of an oral reading, against which Twiggs' own sworn description of the note's location (under Robinson's keyboard) weighs. Qualification the map does not make: Twiggs had read the note by then (02:20:45), so his word "automated" may be DERIVED from the note's own wording rather than independent knowledge of the send mechanism — it is a genuine T1 characterisation but not an independent one. (3) THE NULL AS WORDED IS REFUTED. The row asserts a null for `auto.?text|automated message|auto text` AND the bare stem `auto` "across all twelve held artifacts, both readings." q142_verdicts.claim: Twiggs showed investigators Discord messages attributed to Robinson discussing the rifle and engraved bullets.

q142_verdicts.claim: "On Day 4 (July 9), the two accounts of how this material entered the courtroom are reconcilable... read into the record through testimony, withheld as displayed exhibits." → proposed: T1 available, and the reconciliation as written is wrong; it inverts for the Discord exhibit

q142_verdicts.claim: "Robinson was pacing, 'acting erratically'" — presented as Twiggs' account → proposed: T1 available and it CONTRADICTS the attribution; correction required (questioner's words, partly declined by the witness)
q142_verdicts.basis: day4.txt lines 1347 and 1351. Verified verbatim: [02:25:32] Speaker 2 — "So he acted erratically. Was he pacing? Was he just sitting down, relaxing?" [02:26:07] Twiggs — "No, he was walking around a lot." HEADLINE CONFIRMED: "acting erratically" is the interviewing prosecutor's premise, never Twiggs' word, and the profile presents it as Twiggs' account. NULL VERIFIED AND CAPABLE: case-insensitive grep for /erratic|pacing|paced/ over day1.txt–day5.txt returns exactly TWO hits — line 1347 (the question) and "spaced" at line 6946 (unrelated substring); the pattern is capable of matching "erratic", "erratically", "pacing" and "paced", and day1–day5 hold zero U+FFFE and zero NUL bytes (counted in Python), so both readings coincide. Separately, artifact_search.find(r'erratic\w*') and find(r'pacing|paced\b') under BOTH U+FFFE readings across the other 62 banked artifacts — the mis-banked BAM Franchising file 2026-07-06_gov-uscourts-utd-165286-1-4-1_dc28417731.txt EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED — return zero for "erratic*" and only "fast-paced" in an FBI press conference. NARROWING: "partly declined by the witness" claims more than the source carries. Twiggs' "No" answers a COMPOUND alternative question and is ambiguous as to which alternative it rejects; his substituted description, "he was walking around a lot," is closer to affirming movement than to declining it. The supported statement is that Twiggs never used "erratically" or "pacing" — not that he denied them. STEELMAN LOGGED: Twiggs' 02:24:58 answer opens "Like I said, he was up and around doing a lot of stuff around the house" — "Like I said" points to an earlier statement that is NOT in the published record, because the court ordered ~16m24s of the ~37-minute recording redacted from publication (profile §7.2, verified there against day3/day4). q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 — sworn recorded statement (Ex. 16) played in open court Day 4, at 02:26:44 and 02:24:58, via uncertified Rev machine transcript — carrying the fact that Twiggs so stated under oath; Robinson's stated intention remains attributed, not adopted. Separately fix the same bullet's third quoted fragment, which is not verbatim: 02:27:06 reads "I didn't really want to be at our apartment while any of that was happening, regardless of what went down."

q142_verdicts.claim: Twiggs said he then left too, because he "didn't want to be there regardless of what went down." [proposed: T1, quotation corrected and context added]
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened day4.txt. The quote sits at line 1383, immediately after the (02:27:06) marker, and reads verbatim as the row gives it: "Yeah. And I didn't really want to be at our apartment while any of that was happening, regardless of what went down." The profile's rendering is a compression that drops both "at our apartment" and "while any of that was happening" — correction warranted. SPEAKER ESTABLISHED FROM CONTENT, NOT THE REV LABEL: at day4 02:12:39–02:12:40 the same voice answers "what's your name?" with "My name is Lance Twiggs," and the 02:27:06 turn says "our apartment"; label and content agree. CAPACITY — this is the material finding, and it is stronger than the row assumed: the passage is not a police interview and not live testimony. It is State's Exhibit 16, published at day4 02:10:37 and closed at 02:33:59 ("That concludes state's exhibit 16"), a video-recorded statement taken UNDER OATH with a false-statement admonition (02:11:12–02:11:56, re-administered 02:13:37–02:14:02) expressly "to use your statement here instead of your testimony at a preliminary hearing." I corroborated the rule basis in two other files: the 2026-06-23-pub contempt transcript (Graf, 2026-06-22) — "a video recorded interview of Mr. Twiggs conducted pursuant to Utah Rule of Evidence 1102" — and the 2026-08-11 defence brief — "a recorded interview between the Utah County Attorney's Office and witness Lance Twiggs, St.Ex. 16." Rev renders the rule as "11:02" at day4 02:33:34 (normalisation marked: 11:02 → Rule 1102). day3 01:03:25 and day4 02:38:23 fix the interview as 20 April 2026 at the Utah County Attorney's Office (the second interview), not the Sept. 2025 first one. The 02:24:58 context the row wants added is real and material: he went back because he was returning to his parents' house after Robinson drove off. Antecedent quotes also confirmed verbatim: 02:26:57 "eventually said that he would talk to his parents or turn himself over."
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 — sworn recorded statement of a witness, State's Exhibit 16 (20 April 2026, Utah County Attorney's Office), taken under oath under Utah R. Evid. 1102 and published at the preliminary hearing, day4 02:27:06. Quote corrected in full to "I didn't really want to be at our apartment while any of that was happening, regardless of what went down," with the 02:24:58 context. Caveat that must ride with the upgrade: this is a Rule 1102 statement admitted IN LIEU OF live testimony and never cross-examined (the defence's subpoena application was denied — contempt ruling 2026-06-22); it is not courtroom testimony, and §4's existing note that cross-examination remains unexercised stays true.

q142_verdicts.claim: Date-discrepancy flag: CBS rendered the encounter as "Sept. 12, the day after the shooting"; the weight of the record places it on Sept. 11. [proposed: T1 — resolved outright, flag retirable]
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened day4.txt at the cited span. The exchange is verbatim but the row's framing hides who supplied the date. "When did you first see him on September 11th? So this is the day after the shooting" is the INTERVIEWER (line 1339, between the 02:24:55 and 02:24:58 markers); the witness's answer at line 1343 supplies only "Yeah, I saw him when I woke up" — a narrative opener, not an affirmation of the date premise. The date IS carried, but one turn earlier: at line 1331/1335 (02:24:54–02:24:55) the interviewer asks "did you see Tyler on September 11th?" and the answer is "Yes" — assent to counsel's date, not independent dating. I also read 02:23:32–02:23:33, where the surrender date is put to him as a leading premise ("And he turned himself in on the 11th, right?") and the answer is hedged: "I thought so, yeah." Independent Sept-11 anchors that do NOT depend on the witness: the Information, §The Washington County Investigation — "On the evening of September 11, 2025 … Tyler James Robinson, went to the Washington County Sheriff's Office with his parents and a family friend to turn himself in"; and day3 33:17–36:51 (Davis, sworn). SCOPE I COULD NOT CLOSE: I did not open the CBS piece — nothing in this library reproduces it — so the recording-layer half of the flag (that CBS rendered the encounter as "Sept. 12, the day after the shooting") is not verified by this pass and still rests on the profile's existing T3 citation.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 for the analyst-layer resolution only — the encounter is placed on 11 September 2025 by the sworn Rule 1102 statement (day4 02:24:54–02:24:58, date supplied by the interviewer and assented to by the witness), corroborated independently by the Information's "evening of September 11, 2025" surrender and by Davis's testimony at day3 36:51. The CBS rendering stays T3-as-recorded, unre-verified. The flag may be retired to a corrected-claims entry ONLY with that split preserved and with the note that the witness's own dating was assent to a questioner's premise, hedged as to the surrender date.

q142_verdicts.claim: Robinson surrendered at the Washington County Sheriff's Office around 9–10 p.m. on Sept. 11. [proposed: T1 from Davis's own sworn testimony]
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened day3.txt and the affidavit. Both quotes are verbatim: day3 36:51 "I was told he arrived there about 9:00 PM that evening"; 37:00 "Yeah, he'd come there with his parents and a family friend." Affidavit line 10 — "On 09/12/2025 04:00 the defendant was arrested" — confirmed, and the signature block repeats 09/12/2025 04:00 (line 157); note the booking block at line 140 separately reads "Arrest Date/Time: NONE," a competing field inside the same document. THREE PROBLEMS THE MAP DID NOT SEE. (1) "9–10 p.m." is unsourced. I searched day3, day4, the affidavit, the Information and both Rev press transcripts for `\b10:?0?0?\s*(PM|p\.m\.)` and `\bten\b` — numeral AND word form, so the pattern was capable of matching a 10 p.m. — under BOTH U+FFFE readings via artifact_search.find(); zero hits in any arrival context. Every hit in the corpus is "about/approximately 9:00 PM." The upper bound has no support. (2) Davis's knowledge is expressly second-hand and he said so twice: "I was told" (36:51), and at day4 02:53:39–02:53:46 Hunt asks "although you weren't physically present there yet because you were flying down, how do you know that he arrived approximately around 9:00 PM?" — Davis: "Just based on just the police reports I reviewed and then go back and look at the video and such." He landed ~11:30 p.m. (day3 34:45) and reached the sheriff's office near midnight (35:40). (3) "Surrendered" collapses two events: arrival ~9 p.m. Sept 11 vs formal arrest "about 4:00 AM, I believe, of September 12th" (day3 39:59), the latter matching the affidavit. Speaker basis for the label "Brian Davis": content — at day3 26:54 he gives 18 years with SBI, and the affidavit is signed "/S/ Davis, Brian" / "UTBDAVIS – Brian Davis."
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 (Davis sworn testimony, day3 36:51 and 37:00; affidavit for the arrest time) for: "Robinson arrived at the Washington County Sheriff's Office with his parents and a family friend at about 9:00 p.m. on Sept. 11, and was formally arrested there at about 4:00 a.m. on Sept. 12." Delete "9–10 p.m." — no source in this corpus carries the upper bound. Attach the express derivation: Davis was in flight and gave the 9:00 p.m. figure from police reports and video review, so it is second-hand WITHIN sworn testimony. Keep arrival and arrest distinct.

q142_verdicts.claim: "Twiggs did not turn Robinson in." The surrender chain: mother recognised him → father confronted him → parents convinced him to meet → a family friend, a retired deputy sheriff, persuaded him to surrender. [proposed: T1 with a retired-deputy caveat]
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened the Information (§The Washington County Investigation), the affidavit, and day3. All three quotes verbatim: Information — "convinced Robinson to speak with a family friend who is a retired deputy sheriff. At Robinson's father's request, the family friend met with Robinson and his parents and convinced Robinson to turn himself in"; affidavit line 95 — "a family member of Tyler Robinson reached out to a family friend, who contacted the Washington County Sheriff's Office"; day3 49:23 "His name was Mike Mitchell" and 49:34 "he helped facilitate working with Tyler and his parents with the Sheriff's Department for Tyler to turn himself in." FIVE NARROWINGS. (1) CAPACITY: the Information's entire surrender narrative is prefaced "Robinson's mother stated the following to police." It is the State's recitation of witness statements in a charging filing — T1 as a primary document, but what it carries is an attributed allegation, not a finding. (2) DIRECTION: "mother recognised him" over-reads. The Information says she "saw the photo of the shooter in the news and thought the shooter looked like her son," and the father "agreed that it looked like their son." (3) Davis's sworn description is weaker than the Information's: "a family friend, a good family friend" who "helped facilitate," not "convinced." The stronger verb rests on the filing, not the testimony. (4) The caveat's wording is slightly off. Searching the stem `retire` under both U+FFFE readings across day1–day5, the contempt transcript, the defence brief, the affidavit, the Information and all four Rev official transcripts — EXCLUDING the mis-banked BAM Franchising file 2026-07-06_gov-uscourts-utd-165286-1-4-1_dc28417731.txt — the phrase appears in exactly two places: the Information, and Gray's 2025-09-16 charging conference where he reads the Information aloud. That is one source read twice, not two. Davis never says "retired deputy sheriff" (zero `retire` hits in day1–day5). (5) CONFUSION HAZARD, logged: a DIFFERENT deputy appears in Robinson's own message — "one of my neighbors here is a deputy for the sheriff" (day4 02:49:35; Information; defence brief). A neighbour, not the family friend; do not merge them. CONFIRMED IN THE OTHER DIRECTION: the negative claim is affirmatively supported, not mere silence — the affidavit routes the initiating contact family member → family friend → Washington County Sheriff's Office, and Patel repeats that language publicly on 2025-09-12 (rev_fbi-captures-kirk-shooter).
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 (Information + affidavit as primary filings, plus Davis's sworn testimony at day3 49:23–49:34), marked as the State's ATTRIBUTED recitation of what the mother, father and family friend told police — not a judicial finding. Soften "mother recognised him" to "thought the shooter looked like her son" (father "agreed"). Attribute "convinced Robinson to turn himself in" to the Information; Davis's sworn word is "helped facilitate." Restate the caveat as: the retired-deputy-sheriff descriptor is carried by the Information and by Gray's public reading of the Information — one source, not two — and by no sworn testimony. "Twiggs did not turn Robinson in" stands at T1 on the affidavit's affirmative routing of the contact through the family.

q142_verdicts.claim: "The Daily Mail's early claim that Twiggs 'tipped off police' is contradicted by the official record." [proposed: T1 — refutation now rests on primary documents]
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened the affidavit and the Information. Both quotes verbatim: affidavit lines 114–115 — "Investigators identified an individual as the roommate of Robinson. Investigators interviewed the roommate"; Information, §The Roommate — "Police interviewed Robinson's roommate." I ALSO VERIFIED IN THE OTHER DIRECTION, as required, and log the null: searching `\btip(s|ped|ster|line)?\b`, `came forward`, `reach(ed)?\s+out`, `contact(ed)?\s+(the\s+)?(police|Washington|sheriff)` and `call(ed)?\s+(the\s+)?(police|911|FBI)` across day3, day4, the affidavit, the Information, the contempt transcript and all four Rev official transcripts, under both U+FFFE readings, excluding the mis-banked BAM Franchising file — every "tip" hit is the FBI's public tip line, and every "reached out"/"contacted" hit is the family-member → family-friend → Washington County Sheriff's Office chain. Nothing anywhere places Mr. Twiggs as the initiator. The stem `tip` is capable of matching "tipped," so the null is real. THE ROW'S day3 CITATION IS DEFECTIVE: I read day3 33:17–39:09 directly and it contains ZERO occurrences of "roommate" or "Twigg" — it is Davis's travel to St. George and the interviews of the parents and Mike Mitchell. The roommate first appears at day3 48:45–48:47 ("Lance Twiggs") and the interview count at 01:01:50–01:02:25. SCOPE: I did not open the Daily Mail article; what the Daily Mail actually said is not re-verified by this pass.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 for the primary-document FACTS that carry the refutation (affidavit lines 95 and 114–115; Information §The Roommate) — but the refutation itself remains an ANALYST inference from the direction of initiative (investigators identified and approached the roommate; the sheriff's-office contact came from a family member via a family friend), not a T1 official denial. Replace the day3 33:17–39:09 locator with day3 48:45–48:47 and 01:01:50–01:02:25 for the roommate; keep 33:17–39:09 only for the proposition that the surrender chain ran through the family. State plainly that the Daily Mail's wording was not re-read here.

q142_verdicts.claim: Twiggs spoke to authorities on Sept. 12, 2025 — two days after the shooting and the day after Robinson's surrender. [proposed: T1, with location and interviewing agents added]
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened day3.txt at the cited span. All three elements verbatim: 01:01:53 "Two times."; 01:01:55 "The first time was the early morning hours of September 12th, and that occurred at St. George Police Department."; 01:02:21 "It was FBI agents Larson and Agent Ling." FOUR NARROWINGS. (1) The day4 02:36:46 "variance" is not a witness variance at all — it is Ms. Hunt, counsel, characterising prior testimony ("you testified, I believe yesterday that Mr. Twiggs' first interview was the morning of September 12th, 2025. Is that correct?"), ratified by Davis with "That's correct, yes." Hunt uses the same phrasing again at day3 ~01:03:55. Davis's own words are "early morning hours." Counsel's paraphrase ratified by the witness is not a second account of the time. (2) Davis was NOT present at that interview — day4 02:36:59 "No, I was not there"; his basis is having reviewed the audio/video recording (02:37:18–02:37:21) and spoken to one of the agents who was there (02:37:05). T1 as sworn testimony, derivative as to knowledge. (3) The agent names come from an uncertified Rev machine transcript and are not corroborated by any filing I opened; "Larson" and "Ling" are transcript renderings. (4) DIRECTION — this cuts against the profile's current gloss: "the day after Robinson's surrender" is calendar-true but misleading. Robinson arrived at the sheriff's office about 9:00 p.m. on Sept. 11 and was formally arrested about 4:00 a.m. on Sept. 12 (day3 39:59; affidavit line 10). An interview in the "early morning hours of September 12th" falls in the SAME overnight window as Robinson's formal arrest, and may precede it — not a day later.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 (Davis sworn testimony, day3 01:01:50–01:02:25) for: two interviews of Mr. Twiggs; the first in the early morning hours of 12 September 2025 at the St. George Police Department, with two FBI agents present (names as rendered by the uncertified Rev transcript — "Larson" and "Ling" — not verified against any filing). Add that Davis was not present and testified from his review of the recording and a debrief of one attending agent. Record the day4 02:36:46 "morning of September 12th" as COUNSEL'S PARAPHRASE ratified by the witness, not an independent variance. Replace "the day after Robinson's surrender" with the same-overnight-window framing: the interview occurred in the same overnight hours as Robinson's ~4:00 a.m. formal arrest.

q142_verdicts.claim: Per SBI Agent Brian Davis's July 8 testimony, Twiggs was interviewed twice in total.
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened ~/Documents/Kirk Robinson Research/files - Court record/CR-ACQ-2026-07-27_court-record-artifacts/prelim-hearing-transcripts/day3.txt. The exchange is verbatim at the cited offsets (file lines 1841-1852): Lauren Hunt 01:01:48 'Was he interviewed as part of this investigation?' / Brian Davis 01:01:50 'He was.' / Hunt 01:01:51 'How many times?' / Davis 01:01:53 'Two times.' SPEAKER/CAPACITY CHECK: the count is the witness's own answer, not counsel's premise; content confirms the label (strict Q/A alternation, Davis is the sworn witness on the stand). Davis's capacity is established in the same transcript at 26:17 — 'I'm an agent with the Utah State Bureau of Investigation' — so 'SBI Agent' is carried. Davis then dates them himself: 01:01:55 'The first time was the early morning hours of September 12th, and that occurred at St. George Police Department'; 01:03:25 'April 20th of this year'; and Hunt recapitulates at 01:03:52 'two interviews of Mr. Twiggs, one on the morning of September 12th, 2025, second on April 20th, 2026.' The April 20 attendee list IS present at 01:03:35 as the row states. BOTH-DIRECTIONS CHECK (logged as required): I searched day1-day5 under both U+FFFE readings via artifact_search.find() for 'third interview', 'three times', '3 times', 'a third', 'two interviews', '2 interviews', 'both interviews' — patterns capable of matching a third interview both as numeral and as word; the only Twiggs hit is the 'two interviews' recapitulation. I also read the 2026-06-23 contempt transcript (34 'Twigg' hits) — it references only 'a video recorded interview of Mr. Twiggs conducted pursuant to Utah Rule of Evidence 1102.' Nothing in the corpus asserts a third. DATE CHECK: day3.txt's own Rev page stamp reads 'July 9, 2026', which is the PUBLICATION date, not the hearing date — every day file is stamped one business day after its hearing day (day5 = 'July 13', a Monday, for Friday 07-10). Mapping day3 to hearing day 2026-07-08 is independently cross-checked twice against the profile itself: §5.1 dates Faumuina/Bakker (day2) to July 7, and §3.5 dates the played recording (day4) to July 9. So 'July 8 testimony' is right. FILE HYGIENE: audit() reports 0 NUL and 0 U+FFFE in day3.txt. I never swept the folder, so the mis-banked BAM Franchising v. 'Reckless Ben' file was never in scope.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 (sworn testimony, Davis, day3, hearing day 2026-07-08). Upgrade carried. One optional precision: Davis's 'Two times' answers 'interviewed as part of this investigation', so the exact supported form is 'two interviews in this investigation' rather than 'twice in total'.

q142_verdicts.claim: Twiggs "provided a DNA buccal swab."
q142_verdicts.basis: day3.txt at the cited offsets is verbatim as quoted (file lines 1894-1917): Hunt 01:02:26 'Are you aware of Mr. Twiggs' buccal swab was taken at that time?' / Davis 01:02:29 'I don't recall happening there. I believe it happened later. I'd have to... But it did occur. That was obtained from him.' / Hunt 01:02:39 'But you're not sure if it happened on the 12th?' / Davis 01:02:44 'I don't recall if it was there later at his residence.' / Hunt 01:02:47 'But ultimately a buccal swab was obtained from Mr. Twiggs?' / Davis 01:02:51 'Yes, it was.' So the SPLIT ITSELF IS CONFIRMED: T1 that a swab was obtained, expressly NOT T1 as to when or where — Davis twice disclaims recall. WHERE THE ROW OVERREACHES, on the two 'independent' legs. (a) day2.txt 05:12:18-05:12:34 DOES corroborate — Jennifer Faumuina: Twiggs' DNA 'was obtained by law enforcement officers' / 'And was that by a buccal swab?' / 'Yes.' But the row calls her 'analyst Jennifer Faumuina' and that is a CAPACITY ERROR: at day2 05:01:08 she testifies 'I'm currently a sergeant within the State Bureau of Investigation', and counsel prefaces her at 04:59:43 as 'a sergeant with the SBI'. She is an SBI sergeant who processed scenes and physical evidence, not an analyst. Note she also gives no date or place — so this leg reinforces the 'not T1 as to when or where' half. (b) day2.txt 06:39:11 (Ms. Bakker) does NOT carry the swab at all. I read the full turn: 'Based on reviewing Mr. Twiggs' DNA profile to what I developed from these items, I used him as an elimination sample.' No swab, no collection, no date — it establishes only that a Twiggs reference profile reached the examiner. Citing it for the swab is an unearned leg. SPILLOVER FLAG (adjacent, same claim family, living private individual): §5.1 states the profile came from his 'voluntarily provided buccal swab' on T3 (OANN; Fox). No T1 I opened carries VOLUNTARINESS as to the swab — Faumuina says only 'obtained by law enforcement officers.' Voluntariness IS T1-carried as to the PHONE (day3 01:03:00), not the swab; do not let the two migrate. day2.txt: 0 NUL, 0 U+FFFE.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 that a buccal swab was obtained from Mr. Twiggs (day3 01:02:47-01:02:51, Davis; independently day2 05:12:18-05:12:34, Sgt. Jennifer Faumuina, SBI). NOT T1 as to when or where — Davis expressly does not recall, and Faumuina states no date or place. DROP the day2 06:39:11 Bakker citation from this row (it carries only that a Twiggs reference profile was reviewed as an elimination sample) and correct 'analyst' to 'Sergeant, Utah State Bureau of Investigation.'

q142_verdicts.claim: Twiggs "received limited-use immunity from state and federal prosecutors before cooperating."
q142_verdicts.basis: Both legs open and hold, and the strike is better supported than the map claimed. day3.txt at 01:05:09-01:05:15 is verbatim: Hunt 'Was Mr. Twiggs given use immunity?' / Davis 'Yes, he was.' / Hunt 01:05:13 'By what offices?' / Davis 01:05:15 'The Utah County Attorney's Office as well as the United States Attorney's Office.' (Row cites '01:05:09-01:05:19'; the answer block is 01:05:15 and the next question is 01:05:20 — locator is one block wide, not wrong.) day3 01:03:00 also opens as cited: Davis, on the phone, 'he provided his phone. He did it voluntarily also, provided it to those agents.' day4.txt: the April 20, 2026 recording's own preamble IS in the record, but the quoted words sit in the block stamped 02:11:56, not 02:12:22 — 02:12:22 is Mr. Twiggs' 'Mm-hmm' assent. The words are exact: 'I just want to make sure that our recording here is clear that you've also been given a federal agreement and a state agreement granting you immunity from prosecution for materials that you discuss now.' SPEAKER: Rev labels this 'Speaker 4' — I do NOT resolve that to a person from the label. Content basis for the inference: this speaker administers the oath and the Rule 1102 class-A-misdemeanor admonition, and Davis testified at day3 01:06:08 that the admonition was given 'By Ryan McBride with the Utah County Attorney's Office.' Recorded under oath and played into the hearing record, so T1. WHY THE STRIKE IS STRONGER THAN 'NOT CARRIED': the immunity T1 is tethered to the SECOND interview — Hunt's framing at day3 01:04:13 is 'Before Mr. Twiggs' interview on April 20th, 2026...', and the preamble is inside the April 20, 2026 recording. By then Twiggs had already been interviewed on 2025-09-12, had shown the FBI the messages and allowed them photographed (day4 02:37:48), and had voluntarily provided his phone (day3 01:03:00) — roughly seven months earlier. So 'before cooperating' is not merely unsupported; the T1 record contradicts it. Corroboration, not adopted as a finding: the 2026-06-22 contempt ruling (2026-06-23-pub_rev-contempt-hearing-transcript.txt, which no prior pass had opened) has Judge Graf reciting 'his immunity agreements with the State and federal prosecutors' and, in the court's own voice, 'The court does not minimize the significance of immunity agreements as potential sources of bias.' The first is a recital of defendant's assertion, not a finding, and I mark it as such. (That transcript carries the known 'defenses'/'offenses' garble twice.)
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 for the grant and for the granting offices (day3 01:05:09-01:05:15, Davis; independently the sworn April 20, 2026 recording's preamble at day4 02:11:56, played into the record). STRIKE 'before cooperating' — the T1 places the grant at the second interview (2026-04-20), after the 2025-09-12 interview, the showing of the messages and the voluntary provision of the phone. Recommended replacement: 'received use immunity from the Utah County Attorney's Office and the U.S. Attorney's Office in connection with his April 20, 2026 recorded statement.' Fix the day4 locator to 02:11:56.

q142_verdicts.claim: "He handed over his phone contents: the text thread, the photo of the note, and Discord material."
q142_verdicts.basis: The row's core correction is CONFIRMED verbatim, and the quoted fragment 'a SIAC analyst' is exact. day4.txt 02:58:07, Agent Davis: 'following Lance's first interview at St. George PD, his phone is recovered at that point, taken into evidence. It is downloaded, I believe it was the following day or shortly after that. The FBI transported that phone to the RCFL, which is the Regional Computer Forensic Laboratory in Salt Lake City. The phone was downloaded through Cellebrite. And after that following that download that was complete, SBI received a flash drive containing that download. From there, it went to a SIAC analyst to go through that data of his phone to look for any pertinent evidence or information that may be on there. And at that point that this image of this letter was located.' Reinforced at 03:00:17: 'I have spoken with the SIAC analyst who... found this image.' And 02:57:21 confirms Twiggs disclosed the note VERBALLY in the first interview ('he tells them about this letter note he found under Tyler's keyboard') — the note-photo limb is wrong exactly as the row says. THREE NARROWINGS THE ROW MISSES. (1) The verb is wrong for the surviving limbs too. day4 02:36:28: 'In Lance's first interview, he's showing the FBI agents these text messages, describes them to the agents. And at that time, his phone was photographed'; 02:37:48: 'physically, he shows them the phone and then allows them to photograph the phone'; 02:37:34: the photographer was 'Agent Larson with FBI.' He SHOWED and ALLOWED PHOTOGRAPHS; he did not hand over contents. Endorsing 'T1 for the thread' without fixing 'handed over his phone contents' leaves the same error standing on two limbs. (2) The Discord material has a second, independent provenance the row does not mention: day4 02:52:39-02:52:48, Hunt 'did law enforcement send a subpoena to Discord?' / Davis 'Yes, they did.' / 'Were these messages recovered via that subpoena?' / 'They were.' So Exhibit 16.2 exists both as photos of Twiggs' phone and as subpoena returns — the material did not depend on him. (3) DIRECTION, and it matters for a private individual: the map's own paraphrase says 'phone seized.' That is the map's word. day3 01:03:00 has Davis saying Twiggs 'provided his phone. He did it voluntarily'; day4 says 'recovered... taken into evidence.' 'Seized' should not enter the file. AFFIDAVIT LEG: I opened 2025-09-16_affidavit-of-probable-cause_dc27880530.txt and searched under both U+FFFE readings for 'note', 'keyboard', 'letter', 'handwritten', 'hand written', 'buccal', 'Twigg'. 'note' matched (2 hits, both 'Investigators noted inscriptions') which proves the pattern set was capable; the other six are null. The affidavit describes only the roommate opening Discord, showing messages and allowing photographs. So it corroborates the row negatively — no note-photo on 09/12 — but it is a 3-page probable-cause statement and its silence is weak support, not proof of absence.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 for all three limbs, but the SENTENCE must be rewritten, not just the note limb. Supported form: 'In the September 12, 2025 interview Twiggs showed FBI agents the text thread and the Discord messages and allowed his phone screen to be photographed (Agent Larson), and voluntarily provided the phone itself. The photograph of the handwritten note was not provided by him: the phone was taken into evidence, transported by the FBI to the Regional Computer Forensic Laboratory in Salt Lake City, downloaded via Cellebrite, a flash drive of the download went to SBI, and a SIAC analyst located the image in that data (day4 02:58:07). The same Discord messages were also independently recovered by subpoena to Discord (day4 02:52:39-02:52:48).' Drop 'handed over his phone contents' and do not use 'seized.'

q142_verdicts.claim: "Gov. Cox and Bongino publicly credited this material within days as central to establishing the case."
q142_verdicts.basis: 🚨 THE ROW'S NULL IS REFUTED, IN THE VERY FILE THE ROW CITES. q142_verdicts.claim: "(Booking-time reporting for Robinson conflicts across sources; this document deliberately does not anchor Twiggs' first interview to the booking.)"
q142_verdicts.basis: The T1 is real and opens as cited. day3.txt 46:49, Davis: 'We arrived at the Utah County Jail about 7:00 AM on the 12th, September 12th. And he was formally booked in at about 8:00 AM of that morning. And then I was the booking officer.' (The row's ellipsis elides 'September 12th.'; not material.) Confirmed at 47:05 that he 'filled out the necessary paperwork... with the jail... the probable cause statement.' So T1 IS available and the caveat can be narrowed. THE ROW OVERREACHES IN THREE PLACES. (1) 'Retired' is not supported. Davis's times are express approximations — 'about 7:00 AM', 'about 8:00 AM' — so the T1 supplies a window, not a clock time, and cannot adjudicate a minute-level T3 conflict. (2) The affidavit citation is half-misread. Page 1 does say 'On 09/12/2025 04:00 the defendant was arrested', so the arrest datetime is carried on the face — BUT the same document's submission block reads 'Arrest Date/Time: NONE', an internal inconsistency the row does not flag, and '09/12/2025 04:00' is ALSO the affiant's declaration timestamp ('/S/ Davis, Brian 09/12/2025 04:00'). The '09/12/2025 07:18' value sits in a flattened two-column label/value block ('Probable Cause Entered:' ... 'Probable Cause ID:' ... then the values); it maps to 'Probable Cause Entered' by column order and is consistent with the 07:00 arrival, but that mapping is inferred from layout, not printed adjacently. Say so rather than asserting it flat. I also opened 2026-03-15ca_utah-county-sheriff-office-inmate-custody-booking_dc27880534.txt: its OCR is severely degraded, showing 'Aree 09122025 040000' (corroborating a 09/12/2025 04:00:00 arrest datetime) and a booking field that may read 07:58 but is too mangled to rely on — record as (checkable), not as a finding. (3) DIRECTION, and this is the one that matters for a living private individual: the caveat's second clause is a METHODOLOGICAL COMMITMENT, not a sourcing statement, and the new T1 supports KEEPING it. Twiggs' first interview was 'the early morning hours of September 12th... at St. George Police Department' (day3 01:01:55) while Robinson was being transported to and booked at the Utah County Jail in Provo — separate events, hundreds of miles apart. Retiring the caveat would license precisely the anchoring the file removed; this profile has already been bitten once, at §7.1, where 'day of Robinson's booking' was left standing after §3.7 was corrected. Finally, no held source records what the conflicting T3 accounts actually said, so 'the earlier T3 conflict is resolved' cannot be asserted — the T1 SUPERSEDES the T3, it does not adjudicate it.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: Narrow, do not retire. Supported form: 'T1 (Davis, day 3, 2026-07-08): Robinson arrived at the Utah County Jail about 7:00 AM and was formally booked about 8:00 AM on September 12, 2025, with Davis as booking officer; the affidavit's face records the arrest at 09/12/2025 04:00 and a probable-cause entry timestamp of 09/12/2025 07:18. Earlier T3 booking-time reporting is superseded by this T1, not adjudicated by it. This document still deliberately does not anchor Twiggs' first interview — early morning of September 12 at St. George Police Department — to Robinson's booking in Utah County.' Keep the second clause verbatim; apply the same fix at §7.1.

q142_verdicts.claim: Before the second interview, prosecutors warned Twiggs that knowingly making false statements could constitute a Class A misdemeanor
q142_verdicts.basis: Opened day4.txt lines ~836-846 (Rev 02:11:04-02:12:22). All four elements found verbatim: (1) "Any false statement you make and that you do not believe to be true may subject you to criminal punishment as a class A misdemeanor. Do you understand that?" — "Yes."; (2) the oath at the same moment — "I need to place you under oath and also give you an admonition about false statements. Okay? First, you do solemnly swear or affirm..." — "Yes."; (3) in lieu of prelim testimony, TWICE — "This meeting is to use your statement here instead of your testimony at a preliminary hearing" and "may be presented to a magistrate or a judge in lieu of your sworn testimony at a preliminary examination"; corroborated at day3 Rev 01:06:20-01:06:31. Second carrier confirmed: day3 Rev 01:05:38-01:06:08, admonition given "By Ryan McBride with the Utah County Attorney's Office." DIRECTION FAILURE FOUND IN THE MAP'S OWN WORDING on the obstruction item. The line "It potentially could be used for punishment as a high offense as obstruction of justice" is the speaker's IMMEDIATE CONTINUATION of the false-statement admonition, spoken right after Mr. Twiggs answered "Yes" to it. The antecedent of "It" is the false statement. The map's phrase "was told THE CONDUCT ... could be used for punishment as ... obstruction of justice" invites the reading that Mr. Twiggs was warned his underlying conduct in this case is chargeable as obstruction — the source does not say that, and he is charged with nothing. Two further precision faults in the profile line itself: "prosecutors" is plural but the T1 record identifies ONE (McBride); and "before the second interview" is not what the T1 record shows — the admonition is at the OPENING OF THE RECORDING itself. day3 cannot resolve the timing because Hunt's question was compound ("during his second or before his second interview"); day4 resolves it.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1, two carriers (day4.txt, the April 20 2026 recording as played; day3.txt, Davis sworn) — and verbatim. Write it as: at the opening of the recorded April 20, 2026 statement, a prosecutor of the Utah County Attorney's Office (content-identified as Ryan McBride via Davis) placed Mr. Twiggs under oath and admonished him that a false statement he did not believe to be true could subject him to punishment as a class A misdemeanor, and that the statement was being taken in lieu of his preliminary-hearing testimony; Mr. Twiggs answered that he understood. The "knowingly" element is carried by "that you do not believe to be true" — supported. The obstruction item MUST be written as attaching to the FALSE STATEMENT, not to Mr. Twiggs' conduct: "he was further told a false statement could potentially be punished as a higher offense, obstruction of justice." Quote it as-is or mark the normalisation — "a high offense" is an uncertified Rev machine-transcript reading, most likely a garble of "a higher offense." q142_verdicts.claim: "the ONLY likelihood ratio EVER calculated on Mr. Twiggs alone was 1"
q142_verdicts.basis: I opened day2.txt and day5.txt. VALUE CONFIRMED (Burt: "Is this the likelihood ratio from your Twiggs comparison?" → Bakker: "Yes, it is." → "The likelihood ratio was one."). THE MAP'S LOCATOR IS WRONG: the document is not "Exhibit 39, second page" — it is defence exhibit "Baker 38, pages 39 through 44", a six-page STRmix report of "a comparison of the sample to Mr. Twiggs alone" (Burt at 07:06:09–07:07:00; the court admitting it at 07:08:40: "So Baker 38, pages 39 through 44 is admitted"). "39" is a PAGE inside Tab 38; "Second page" is the second page of that displayed range. THE MAP IS ALSO WRONG THAT "only" IS PURE INFERENCE FROM SILENCE: Bakker affirmatively, though hedged, testified to singularity at 07:04:56–07:05:27 — "at that time, I believe I ran statistics with just Twiggs comparing that individual to the sample... I think that was the only additional" and "After discussion with my reviewer, it was determined that I was also going to calculate a statistic or compare Twiggs by himself." BUT "EVER" IS AFFIRMATIVELY REFUTED BY DAY 5, so the map's proposed restatement is still too strong: ATF examiner Caitlin Oliver testified her laboratory reports the likelihood ratio with every conclusion ("we report the likelihood ratio and either support or support for inclusion or support for exclusion", 01:24:09), that an inclusion conclusion has "a likelihood ratio statistic calculated and to go along with that" (01:50:08, said of another elimination donor), and that ATF report 157 recorded "support for inclusion of Lance Twiggs on swabs of buttons of a Dremel tool" and on "other areas of the Dremel tool" (01:50:37–01:51:44). So further Twiggs likelihood ratios exist in report 157; none was stated aloud. "No other Twiggs likelihood ratio appears anywhere in the five evidentiary days" would read as though none exists.
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: Two separately graded statements. (a) T1: "the likelihood ratio on the STRmix report comparing the sample to Mr. Twiggs alone — defence exhibit Baker 38, pp. 39–44, admitted Day 2 — was 1." (b) Medium-high, on the witness's own hedged testimony ("I believe" / "I think"): "that was the only additional statistic Bakker ran on Mr. Twiggs in the FBI casework." DELETE "ever" and delete the map's proposed "no other Twiggs likelihood ratio appears anywhere in the five evidentiary days"; the supported form is "no other Twiggs likelihood-ratio VALUE was stated aloud across the five evidentiary days — and the Day 5 testimony affirmatively indicates further Twiggs likelihood ratios exist in ATF report 157, unstated on the record (still (checkable) against report 157)." The proposition strings are verbatim and appear TWICE from independent mouths: Faumuina reading State's Exhibit 31 at stream offsets 05:10:57 and 05:11:41 ('…1.7 octillion times more likely if Twiggs and T. q142_verdicts.claim: Mixed male DNA from two individuals was reported on (a) the dark towel wrapped around the Mauser 98 rifle recovered in the woods and (b) the screwdriver recovered from the Losee Center rooftop

Yes.' at 08:07:18–08:07:21. NARROWINGS: (1) 'a wooded area… northeast of campus' is COUNSEL'S premise — McBride asked 'Is there a wooded area that's northeast of campus?' and Faumuina answered 'Yes' (05:03:09). Her own words are 'a long gun that was wrapped in a dark-colored towel' and 'it was a Mauser 98 rifle' (05:03:16, 05:03:26). The map formats counsel's phrase as her quotation. (2) The day1 Bagley string is a SPLICE of two answers across an intervening Q&A: 'It was a red and black screwdriver.' (01:43:39) and, after four turns, 'That's a picture of the screwdriver that I saw that day on top of the rooftop of the Losee building.' (01:44:10) — and the second describes State's Exhibit 3.1, a photograph, not the object. It must not be printed as one continuous utterance. (3) REV LABEL HAZARD, live here: every one of those answers is labelled 'Richard Novak' — a defence attorney's name. Resolution to Bagley rests on in-transcript basis, stated: Grunander's 'the state calls Officer Chris Bagley' (43:27), the judge addressing 'Officer Bagley', Grunander's 'I am going to refer the witness, on your screen, Officer Bagley, to State's Exhibit 3.1' (01:43:45), and decisively the witness spelling his own name under the mislabelled turn — 'Christopher Bagley. Last name spelling B-A-G-L-E-Y' (44:50). He was the State's first witness, then UVU PD. (4) SILENT DEPENDENCY: 'two individuals' is a REVISED conclusion. Bakker testified she first read three contributors around September 12 and 'changed my conclusion on September 13th of 2025' after 'I was submitted an elimination sample from Mr. Twiggs' (06:33:03–06:33:52). (5) The map mis-describes the item-to-object mapping as 'on McBride's examination of Bakker' for the Faumuina material — the Item 7/8 descriptions were read by Faumuina on McBride's direct of Faumuina; the Bakker confirmation was on McBride's CROSS (Bakker was a defence witness, see row 4).
q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1 on all elements, with four carried qualifications: 'wooded area / northeast of campus' = counsel's premise ADOPTED by the witness (not her phrasing); the Bagley material = two separate answers, the second describing State's Ex. 3.1 (a photograph), speaker resolved to Officer Christopher Bagley on his own in-transcript self-identification at 44:50 despite the 'Richard Novak' label; 'two individuals' = the report's REVISED count, changed 2025-09-13 upon receipt of the Twiggs elimination sample (day2.txt 06:33:30–06:33:52); attribution corrected to Faumuina on McBride's direct (day2.txt) plus Bakker on McBride's cross (08:07:18) plus Bagley on Grunander's direct (day1.txt).

For one of the runs when I compared to Mr. Robinson conditioning on Mr. Twiggs, it was a 5% to 95%.' q142_verdicts.corrected_marking: T1, as proposed, with the 79%/89% transcript-artifact caveat carried in the file and the proportions attributed to STRmix's estimate ('I did not calculate that personally', 05:53:41). Two mandatory fixes on application: correct the profile's mis-transcribed quotation to Bakker's actual words at 08:05:58, and do not describe Burt's questioning as cross-examination — Bakker was a defence witness (day2.txt 04:59:43, 07:03:46, 07:45:22, 08:08:34).
